stories.title: Walmart, Sam’s Club to Roll Out Tap to Pay… Finally
stories.summary: Walmart, Sam’s Club to Roll Out Tap to Pay… Finally WENY News

stories.title: Oil Rises as US Targets Iran's Economy
stories.summary: Crude extended its rally as Asian demand strengthened while the Iran conflict continued to constrain global supplies.

stories.title: Iran President Urges End to War while Refusing to Call Defeat
stories.summary: 'It would be better to end the war today, when we have power and dignity, and with the whole world acknowledging our victory', Masoud Pezeshkian said, according to the semi-official Iranian Students' News Agency.

stories.title: Court Upholds Trump Admin Order to Restart SYU
stories.summary: The Justice Department claimed 'a significant victory for President Trump's efforts to unleash American energy'.

stories.title: Norway Union, Helicopter Group Start Talks to Avert Strike
stories.summary: The Styrke union warned of an immediate strike should negotiations with the Federation of Norwegian Aviation Industries do not result in an agreement.

stories.title: Buru Mulls Mini Refinery in Western Australia
stories.summary: Buru said it plans to build a mini-refinery to supply the Kimberley region as part of a new sales model for the remaining volumes in the Ungani field in the Canning Basin.

stories.title: Equinor Secures Deal to Supply Crude to ORLEN
stories.summary: ORLEN signed a three-year agreement to buy five to more than nine million metric tons a year of crude oil from Norway.

stories.title: Vitol Bunkers, Olam Agri complete world’s 1st coprocessed VLSFO biobunkering operation
stories.summary: Supplied in Singapore, the operation used VLSFO coprocessed with cashew-nut shell liquid (CNSL), showcasing a waste-to-energy approach.

stories.title: European Energy, Mitsui secure OMV as new offtaker for Kassø eMethanol facility in Denmark
stories.summary: The agreement is the fourth publicly announced long-term offtake for eMethanol produced at the Kassø facility.

stories.title: Vancouver International Airport initiative enables travelers to support SAF use
stories.summary: A new online calculator gives passengers the opportunity to estimate carbon emissions of their flight and contribute to the use of SAF.

stories.title: XCF Global ships 55,000 gallons of renewable diesel daily
stories.summary: By establishing this daily baseline output, XCF said it is providing shareholders with “clear, verifiable proof of physical output and commercial execution.”

stories.title: Dangote Offers East African States 30 Pct Stake in Planned Refinery
stories.summary: Dangote Group has offered East African countries a 30 percent equity stake in the giant refinery planned for the region, according to Kenyan President William Ruto's top economic adviser.

stories.title: Various Tankers Shuttle Saudi Oil North to Evade Houthis
stories.summary: Shipowners including Sinokor Group are helping Saudi Arabian crude exit the Red Sea via the safer northern route, as Iran-backed militants target the kingdom's exports via the Bab el Mandeb chokepoint in the south.
